subject: Add rain and wet surface effects: overlay a naturalistic rain streak layer with depth-varying rain density (heavier in background, lighter in foreground), add wet-surface specular reflections on horizontal surfaces such as roads, rooftops, and skin, add small water droplets on the lens edge areas creating out-of-focus bokeh beads, introduce a slight overall desaturation and cool temperature shift typical of overcast rainy conditions. The rain should feel heavy, real, and cinematically moody.
